findings.statement: The phase-factored candidate remains Q-V exact on all eight complete controls but is Q-A exact only on 3x3-k3. It fails transporter-aware action-value sufficiency on 3x4-k3, 4x3-k3, 4x4-k4, 4x4-k3, 3x5-k3, 5x3-k3 and fresh 3x6-k3.

Replacing rank mod 3 with exact rank does not repair Q-A: exact-rank + component parity + T2 fails Q-A on the same seven carriers. The missing action information is therefore not merely a coarser rank-phase alias.

Component parity + T2 without the rank phase fails Q-A on all eight carriers. Rank phase repairs the 5x3 scalar collision but does not restore the action multiplicity/type distinctions discarded by parity.

Every tested carrier larger than 3x3 has a nontrivial class reduction under the phase-factored Q-V key relative to full component multiplicity, and every such carrier fails Q-A. The sole Q-A pass, 3x3-k3, has no class reduction for the phase-factored key relative to MULTI.

T2-W and T2-L2 states have direct scalar values from mover identity: W fixes value to the mover's win sign and L2 fixes value to the mover's loss sign. Q-V may therefore forget the number and identity of winning/losing actions that Q-A must retain.

The Q-A gap is not confined to already scalar-absorbed T2-W/L2 states. For example, 4x4-k4 has a phase-factored Q-A collision inside T2-O, so unresolved scalar states can still share value while having different action-value interfaces.
The phase-factored candidate is a scalar quotient only. It must not be promoted as a move-selection or action-value representation; Q-A requires a finer carrier even where Q-V is already exact.

For the Q-V/D_G campaign, valuation discovery should now focus on T2-O states after phase factorization, because W/L2 already have direct values. Q-A should continue as a separate finer-quotient channel rather than forcing action information back into the scalar carrier.

interpretation_guard: Q-A failure does not weaken the Q-V result.
Q-V success does not license action selection from the compressed key.
No XOR/component valuation law follows from the Q-V quotient alone.
The correct next scalar target is the unresolved T2-O phase-factored carrier, not restoration of Q-A distinctions.
